notes.title: Patch #4 (minor update)
notes.notes:
I am still chasing that sweet green checkbox for being fully verified on Steam Deck. Although those in the know can tell you it plays beautifully on there already, there are some sync issues that could make it annoying to switch between deck and PC and downgrade us to only "playable".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/b47d117833222d4791cbc6ddff6bb3b5618ae370.jpg[/img]

While I was tackling that, I went through all the bug reports you lovely, lovely people have sent through the game's feedback menu (thank you! ːexoflexː) and fixed some small issues with particular cards and rare errors. Here's the list:

[list]
[*] Typos typos teh-zypos! ("only" 20 of them)
[*] Make Small Skills Boost perk and Clear Minded status roll their chances separately instead of adding them together in a confusing way
[*] Fix Bravely Helping to Fight and other +1 to total cards showing bonus beside the total, but not actually adding it to the total on rounds 2 and 3
[*] Fix Tracking the Airsquid card text to explain it only affects physical cards
[*] Confirmation dialog when forgetting or not forgetting a card while relaxing, so it's much harder to skip by that option by accident
[*] Warn in a popup the first five times any file fails to save during each play session
[*] Slightly speed up first game boot after install or update (stop unnecessarily recompiling story files)
[*] Fix controllers not closing text input popups on Steam Deck
[*] Hide resolution and quality settings on Steam Deck and stop syncing them between deck and pc, just default to what works best on that specific hardware
[/list]

- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: Exocolonist Patch #3 (version 2716) changelog!
notes.notes:
I Was a Teenage Exocolonist [b]Patch #3[/b], version 2716 (March 16) is up now on Steam!

This build restores some accidentally lost content, adds custom cursors, fixes issues with equipment bonuses and some statuses, and a bunch more small issues and typos.

[list]
[*] store hogs in save files and offer to restore if Groundhogs.json corrupt
[*] improve loading an age 11+ game in a demo version
[*] custom cursors, can be disabled via settings, bigger on 4k
[*] better fix for cards getting stuck
[*] redirecting thumper now adds to defense one time
[*] immediately skip current card challenge when you disable it via tutorial
[*] show card art and text in controller tooltips that include both
[*] strip exoscript markup from all user-entered names
[*] fix starting the game in controller mode with no controller plugged in
[*] fix hitting home with H hotkey while entering name if input box loses focus
[*] fix feedback menu truncating jankily after 13 lines
[*] fix tooltips disappearing too fast when using mouse and keyboard together
[*] fix steam deck tutorial where it says "click" so we can finally be verified
[*] fix disabling past lives with negative checks
[*] fix WAKE UP font being huge sometimes
[*] fix medallion and other gear bonuses that should only be on the first round
[*] fix becoming enlightened after first or second perk with gear skill bonuses
[*] fix fillbars not showing changes when gear bonuses push skill over 100
[*] fix autosaving when returning from an expedition before the date changes
[*] fix showing -15 when you have net +0 skill change and gear equipped
[*] fix calm and starving statuses not affecting skill changes
[*] fix not showing skill bonus info in bubble tooltip when net is +0
[*] fix remove incrementMonth to keep from skipping important events
[*] fix opening credits menu during ending doesn't let you close it again
[*] fix upgrading hopeye
[*] fix missing skill card sub-events for vace/rex/nomi/sym
[*] fix old sol not saying interesting things about many endings
[*] a regular helping of narrative fixes and typos
[/list]

Another giant thank you to everyone who reported bugs from inside the game's feedback menu! I couldn't have found these without you! ːexoflexː

- Sarah

notes.title: Exocolonist Patch #2 (version 2315) changelog!
notes.notes:
I Was a Teenage Exocolonist [b]Patch #2[/b], version 2315 (November 15th) is up now on Steam!

More typos and a few bugs with gear and collectibles squashed. Patch notes:

[list]
[*] fix double-equipping gear when upgrading, not being able to equip
[*] fix crystal cluster making cards unselectable in controller mode
[*] fix negative skill bonuses for statuses (mourning, injured etc)
[*] fix (hopefully) can't drag battle cards in mouse mode
[*] fix (maybe) groundhogs steam sync issue, stop saving on game exit
[*] fix gear menu card scaling in biggerMenus mode
[*] fix some job start events that weren't high priority
[*] fix a bunch of references after you preempt famine
[*] move hard-coded english strings into localization tsv for modding
[*] buncha typos
[/list]

One bug I'm hoping to (maybe) fix with this update is an issue where past memories are disappearing (characters from the main menu, endings and achievements in the gallery). This might be due to a Steam sync issue reverting the file Groundhogs.json. If you think this might still be happening to you with the new version 2315, please report it from inside the game, and if possible please also email your Steam cloud_log.txt and cloud_log previous.txt files to support@finji.co (C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\logs on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/logs on MacOS, ~/.local/share/Steam/logs on Linux).

Another issue I haven't been able to track down is fast-disappearing tooltips. They're supposed to stick around under your mouse, not disappear after a second! If this is happening to you (especially if you can figure out why!) please report it from inside the game.

Thank you for all your help!
- Sarah ːnyaaː

notes.title: Exocolonist Patch #1 (version 2204) changelog!
notes.notes:
I Was a Teenage Exocolonist [b]Patch #1[/b], version 2204 (October 4th) is now live on Steam!

It fixes a few big bugs (the gym does something now!), a bunch of rarer issues (all cards now gettable!), plus better support for the Steam Deck and non-16:9 aspect ratios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/c266913c6e7024ab43352984112978c8f24d91a4.gif[/img]
No more letterboxing - resize the game window to whatever scale you want!

Thank you [b]so so so much[/b] to everyone who sent in bug reports and helped me track these down, especially machine-specific problems and all those obscure typos and issues in hidden corners of the narrative.

If you run into any more problems, please report them from inside the game so it sends me your logs and stuff too!

notes.title: One week until release (new trailer!)
notes.notes:
On Thursday August 25th at 10am PT we'll finally loose our arrow into the world, piercing the hearts of narrative rpg fans as they live (and re-live) their teenage years on the planet Vertumna.

[previewyoutube=oRRanzUQ0Vw;full][/previewyoutube]

Our new launch trailer features beautiful rock-ballad "The Child You Were" by [url=http://francesaravel.com]Frances Aravel[/url], and powerful imagery from emotional moments in the game. I'm not crying, you're crying. 

Our sound designer Em Halberstadt from [url=https://ashellinthepit.com/]A Shell in the Pit Audio[/url] created it with help from Emily Liles and friends from Finji.

I'm as nervous as a hopeye about the upcoming launch!! I hope you're excited to play I Was a Teenage Exocolonist soooooooooon. 

- Sarah ːnyaaː
